title: About alerts
body:
Can the rising（Falling） threshold be set to be adjustable?  Fixed 0.1mmol / l and 0.16mmol / l, too few options.
Or add 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, etc.  Thank you for your development, this project has benefited me a lot.@bigdigital

comments.body: The alert thresholds can be adjusted directly in the xdrip settings. Just go to Settings-> Alarm and alerts -> Glucose level alert list and configure thresholds for low and high alerts.

> 警报阈值可以直接在xdrip设置中进行调整。只需转到“设置”->“警报和警报”->“葡萄糖水平警报”列表，然后为低警报和高警报配置阈值。

Hello there.  I may not be able to express clearly. What I am saying is that in other alarms, the rate of rise of blood glucose and the rate of decrease of blood glucose.
"Settings"-> "Alarms and Alarms"-> "Other Alarms"-> "Rapid Blood Sugar Rise"-> "Rising Threshold"

A lower threshold, of 1, has been added. You can test it by updating to the latest Nightly build.
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2021.04.06

Please report here:(https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/907) if you discover any unexpected behavior.
Thanks
